# Use of AI (transparency)

The subject asks for a mature, transparent and responsible use of AI.

* **What was generated by AI**: the first complete draft of this repository (backend, tests, mobile app, docs, benchmark script) was produced by an AI coding assistant (Claude) from the subject PDF.
* **What it was used for**: scaffolding, writing tests, and a smoke test of the stack.
* **What humans must still do before the defence** (the AI is not responsible for your decisions):
  1. Read every file and be able to explain each design decision (see "Technical choices" in the README): why SQLite + transactions, why opaque tokens, how a concurrent move is resolved, how the geo/time licence can be bypassed (GPS spoofing).
  2. Review the code with your peers, challenge the trade-offs, adapt what does not fit your team (language, DB, UI).
  3. Re-run `make test` and `make bench` on **your** hardware and update `docs/PERFORMANCE.md` with your own numbers and machine description.
  4. Create your Google/Facebook credentials and test social login on a device.
* **Good practice followed**: tests written for each layer and reviewed against edge cases (duplicates, parallel requests, permissions).
